items.title: Apple reports second quarter results
items.snippet: Apple reported fiscal 2026 second-quarter revenue of $111.2 billion and said iPhone achieved a March quarter revenue record, fueled by extraordinary demand for the iPhone 17 lineup.

items.title: aapl-20260328
items.snippet: SEC filing for Apple’s fiscal 2026 second quarter / six months ended 2026-03-28; includes risk disclosures and financial statements.

items.title: Apple reports fourth quarter results
items.snippet: Apple reported fiscal 2025 fourth-quarter revenue of $102.5 billion and stated it was heading into the holiday season with its most extraordinary product lineup.

items.title: aapl-20250927
items.snippet: SEC annual report filing for Apple’s fiscal 2025 year-end includes risk factors such as inventory, manufacturing purchase obligations, and demand-related risks.
